originalPromptTexts: Many religious ideologies attempt to co-opt the wonder we experience in our world to illegitimately suggest their particular deity is the source of that wonder. Comment on the ubiquity, deceitfulness, and illogic of this leap from wonder to a particular God.
Elaborate on how wonders and mysteries in our experience do not require that we force a conclusion about the source of those wonders and mysteries.
How can we detect and respond to those using this deceitful tactic?
